The FSF copyright, driver identification and notice at bytes [190,2512) establish the witness. Its GPL-2.0-or-later notice permits copying, distributing and modifying output configure scripts. The License Index taxonomy at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7, SCOPE.md bytes [640,783), admits an additional permission with separate evidence of its base edition. The driver's own GPL notice and conditional output permission meet those criteria.

limitations: The publisher file contains the operative notice. The Index supplies the 2.59 edition mapping and the SPDX 3.29.0 form label. The notice prints no independent exception version number. A release tag or archive was not separately inspected.
